case_name: Church of God (Full Gospel) In India v K. K. R. Majestic Colony Welfare Association and Others
petitioner: Church of God (Full Gospel) In India
respondent: K. K. R. Majestic Colony Welfare Association
holding: The rules prescribing reasonable restrictions including the rules for the use of loudspeakers and voice amplifiers framed under the Madras Town Nuisance Act,1889 and also the Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000 are required to be enforced.
